headline: Verstappen wins a chaotic, rain-hit Singapore Sprint and starts today's GP from pole, Brendan Allen chokes out Christian Leroy Duncan in the fifth, and GPT-6 rolls out to every ChatGPT user.

upcoming.what: F1 Singapore Grand Prix, 13:00 Irish time — Verstappen on pole, Leclerc and Hamilton behind
Battlefield 6 and Valor Mortis join Game Pass; Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 release
GTWC Europe Endurance finale, 3 Hours of Portimão, 17:00–20:00 (same time as Ireland)
UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs Malott (Edmonton) — main card in the small hours of Sunday, Irish time
F1 United States Grand Prix, Austin (Irish clocks go back on the 25th)

items.headline: Verstappen wins rain-hit Singapore Sprint; Russell crashes, McLarens collide
items.summary: Russell grabbed the lead at the start and binned it at the final corner of lap one, leaving Max to win from Hamilton, Leclerc and Antonelli. Norris tipped Piastri into a spin and finished eighth, with Oscar a lapped 14th.

items.headline: Verstappen takes GP pole by 0.054s from Leclerc
items.summary: A clean sweep of Saturday for Max: Leclerc and Hamilton make it Ferrari 2-3, with Antonelli fourth and Norris fifth. Russell qualified sixth but drops back with an engine-change grid penalty; lights out at 13:00 Irish time.

items.headline: GTWC Europe finale moved to Saturday evening
items.summary: Next weekend's 3 Hours of Portimão title decider now runs 17:00–20:00 on Saturday 17 October, shifted to avoid clashing with the WEC's 6 Hours of Barcelona.

items.headline: Brendan Allen submits Christian Leroy Duncan late in round five
items.summary: Allen took the English middleweight's back and finished him with a rear-naked choke at 2:46 of the fifth (Duncan had lost a point for an eye poke). Allen, now on four straight wins, asked for a title shot and called out Dricus du Plessis.

items.headline: UK win for Jai Herbert; Prado flattens the overweight Bonfim
items.summary: England's Jai Herbert edged Matheus Camilo on all three cards in the co-main. Francisco Prado knocked out Ismael Bonfim (who missed weight by 7.5lb) in round one, and Andre Fili and Otari Tanzilovi both scored head-kick-assisted KOs.

items.headline: GPT-6 rolls out to all ChatGPT users
items.summary: OpenAI is pushing GPT-6 worldwide with an 'Intelligent UI' that can answer with charts, diagrams and forms. Paid tiers get the GPT-6 Sol model; free users get a GPT-6 Luna-based model.

items.headline: Qualcomm to license patents to Huawei for the first time
items.summary: A notable thaw: Qualcomm has reportedly agreed a patent licence with Huawei, pending approval. Separately, Tencent is said to be leasing roughly $7bn of AI compute from Oracle over five years at well below typical H100 rates.

items.headline: Windows Search gets a faster, launcher-style rebuild
items.summary: Microsoft is testing a WinUI 3 Windows Search with typo tolerance, inline file previews and quick actions like toggling dark mode — Insiders' Experimental Channel only for now.

items.headline: CME hit sparks a strong G3 geomagnetic storm
items.summary: NOAA says a CME arrived mid-afternoon Saturday and pushed the storm to G3 by about 18:00 UTC — the aurora chance flagged yesterday materialised. Activity was expected to ease after midnight, but it's worth a glance north tonight if skies are clear.

items.headline: Physicists finally observe 'Bethe strings' predicted in 1931
items.summary: An Innsbruck-led team trapped ultracold caesium atoms in thin 1D tubes and directly saw Hans Bethe's bound particle clusters — some of six or more atoms — surviving collisions.

items.headline: 9-billion-year-old hydrogen signal offers a cheap dark-energy probe
items.summary: Canada's CHIME radio telescope picked up faint emission from hydrogen when the universe was about five billion years old, pointing to a lower-cost way to map cosmic expansion.

items.headline: GTA VI's radio stations revealed
items.summary: Rockstar has detailed six stations (Latin, country, African, metal, pop and hip-hop) plus on-demand podcasts. Still on track for 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — no PC date.

items.headline: Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 slips to January 2027
items.summary: Playground confirms the PS5 version now lands 26 January 2027, with Premium early access and the first expansion (all platforms) on 21 January.

items.headline: Rider Zuchi stripped of IBJJF heavyweight world title
items.summary: His Worlds sample from May came back positive for steroids; USADA gave him a three-year ban (reduced for admitting it). Nicholas Maglicic is promoted to world champion.

items.headline: FloGrappling boss says UFC BJJ is losing money
items.summary: Flo GM Ben Kovacs reckons the UFC's grappling events don't add up financially given athlete pay demands and likely subscriber numbers — a rival's view, so pinch of salt. Otherwise a quiet weekend for results.
